note: Manual curation layer for the political seed. `committees`: force-include (or, prefixed with '!', exclude) FEC committee IDs per ticker. `ldaClients`: force-include/exclude Senate LDA client IDs. `excludeEmployerStrings`: normalized employer strings to ignore. Every entry should cite why in `reasons`. Empty by default — the matcher is conservative and logs its choices; review db.political_committee / lobbying_client after a run and add corrections here.
